name: daily-communications-brain
purpose: Compile actionable Gmail and Slack evidence into Dillon OS without copying raw archives or crossing client boundaries.

steps.task: Load vault rules, canonical client registry, prior checkpoint, and verify the exact Gmail account and Slack workspace.
constraints: read-only connector access
fail closed on account or workspace mismatch
never retrieve or persist authentication challenges or secrets

steps.task: Search Gmail and all authorized Slack conversation types from the last successful checkpoint with a 36-hour overlap.
constraints: metadata and snippets first
exclude spam, trash, promotions, newsletters, bot noise, OTP, MFA, recovery, billing-card, and credential material
paginate through the bounded time window

steps.task: Read only the complete threads needed to verify decisions, commitments, deliverables, deadlines, blockers, meetings, metrics, client changes, and reusable process knowledge.
constraints: do not copy raw message bodies into the vault
treat automated summaries as leads until the source thread is verified
record evidence freshness and uncertainty
upstream_artifacts: bounded Gmail and Slack candidate locators

steps.task: Route every selected item to one exact client, Align HCM, a personal venture, operations, or unresolved review, then write a normalized run envelope.
constraints: canonical client registry controls routing
ambiguous items go to unresolved review and do not mutate client truth
one evidence item may not blend multiple clients
normalized envelopes contain summaries and receipts, never raw archives

steps.task: Run the deterministic communication ingester, then update existing canonical client, project, decision, research, SOP, and approval notes only where the evidence supports a durable change.
constraints: update existing canonical notes before creating new ones
add dated source_refs and preserve source freshness
communication evidence does not authorize sends, publishing, spend, account changes, or delivery
Marketing Chief remains the only canonical queue writer

steps.task: Refresh maps and coverage, run tests and health checks, wait for Obsidian Sync, and report only material changes, blockers, and the next safe action.
constraints: do not advance a failed connector checkpoint
do not claim sync without current CLI evidence
never send or post during the compile

failure_policy.gmail_failed: Preserve the Gmail checkpoint, continue Slack only, mark the run degraded.
failure_policy.slack_failed: Preserve the Slack checkpoint, continue Gmail only, mark the run degraded.
failure_policy.both_failed: Write no source-derived updates and notify Dillon of the connector failure.
failure_policy.ambiguous_route: Write the item only to unresolved review and never to a client record.
failure_policy.validation_failed: Write no capture, review, queue item, or checkpoint.
